player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} ({piece}). Opponent is ({opp}). Submit moves as '[b1 c3]' (from → to). All pieces move like chess knights.
Each capture scores {score_per_capture} point. Game ends after {max_moves} moves or when a player has no legal move / no pieces. Higher score wins.

invalid_move.bad_format: E sega ni vinaka na kena ituvatuva. Vakayagataka '[b1 c3]'.
invalid_move.unknown_square: Na lomanibai e sega ni kilai.
invalid_move.not_your_piece: E sega ni nomu itavi na ivurevure.
invalid_move.own_piece: Sega ni rawa nira cegu ena nodra vanua.

game_action.moved: Player {player_id} e dabe e dua na nona piece mai {frm} ki {to}.
game_action.capture: {observation} Na qai vakadidike e dua na piece! (+{score_per_capture})

outcome.no_pieces: Sega ni dua na tiki e tu vua o koya e qito {player_id}.
outcome.cannot_move: Sega ni rawa me toso na dauqito {player_id}.
outcome.higher_score: Levu na ka e rawa ni tauri.
outcome.move_limit: Sa yaco na iyalayala ni kena rawa.
